summary: Iteration 83 tested property viewing bookings (backend and UI) and the new kind-coloured map pins. Backend: the existing test_viewings.py passes (4/4). The new rules suite passes 7 of 9 tests and the race test passes 1 of 1. One real bug: POST /viewings/{id}/complete accepts a confirmed viewing that hasn't started yet. The second failure was a knock-on from that bug, and the test has been adjusted. Gating works: a locked user gets 402 on booking and on the availability call, and the UI shows the Unlock CTA with no Book viewing button and no auto-open on ?book=1. An agent on their own listing gets 400 from the API and sees Manage in the UI. Only the side named in `awaiting` can confirm (the other side gets 409). Decline is agent-only (403 for the buyer). A stranger gets 403 on GET. Time rules work (under 1h ahead, more than 30 days ahead, outside hours, and a slot ending after the window close all return 400). Duplicates and clashes return 409, including 6 parallel duplicate POSTs, which created exactly one request. All 5 notification kinds arrive with meta.viewing_id and action_url /viewings/{id}. Email failures are logged as WARNINGs, as expected. UI buyer flow: the sheet shows the hours hint 'Mon–Sun 09:00–17:00', hides past or under-1h slots, marks the confirmed 15:00 slot 'Taken' and disabled, and keeps submit disabled until a slot is picked. After booking: toast 'Viewing requested', the CTA becomes the viewing time, the status row reads 'Awaiting agent', tapping it opens /viewings/{id}, and there is no money rain. UI agent flow: Requests chip with count 1 and '1 request waiting for your reply.' Detail shows Needs your reply with Confirm, Suggest and Decline (no Cancel). Confirm gives Confirmed plus exactly one money-rain-subtle. The agent can suggest 17:00, outside their own hours; the agent then sees 'Awaiting reply' and the buyer sees 'New time — confirm?' with 'Confirm Tue 27 Oct · 17:00'. Buyer confirm rains once (money-rain-subtle). Buyer cancel gives Cancelled, and the timeline is newest first. Decline opens the reason sheet; the buyer then sees Declined plus the reason, and 'Request another time' opens /property/..?book=1 with the sheet already open. Free mode (Tunde, no hours) shows 'hasn't set viewing hours' and 09:00–17:00 starts. Availability screen: Save is disabled until something changes. Setting Mon only with 45-min slots made the buyer sheet enable only Mondays, with slots 09:00…15:45. Tapping a notification deep-links to the viewing detail. Map: Buy/Rent/Lease segment dots are #1F9D55/#E11B22/#2563EB. Sale, rent and lease pins use the same colours with white text. Unlocked pins have a 2px gold border and a lock-open icon. The selected pin is #111. A viewed pin is white with green text and border. The preview 'FOR SALE' badge is green. No pin text is clipped inside its pill. Pin tap gives one money-rain-brief, and opening the property from the preview adds no second rain.

minor.issue: Accepts a CONFIRMED viewing whose start is in the FUTURE (returned 200 for a viewing 4 days out). Only can_complete checks start <= now; the endpoint itself never checks it. Fix: add `_parse(v['start']) > _now()` → 409 in complete_viewing (viewings.py:410-415).

HoursWindow only checks the regex \d{2}:\d{2}, so '09:00'–'99:99' was saved (200). Overlapping windows are also accepted. With such hours stored, _inside_hours calls local.replace(hour=99) → ValueError → 500 on POST /viewings and buyer propose. Validate 00:00–23:59 (also 24:00 if needed) and reject overlaps.

_transition checks state and then writes without a condition: update_one({id}) has no status/awaiting precondition. Two near-simultaneous actions can therefore both succeed, e.g. buyer cancel and agent confirm, which sends both notifications. Confirming two overlapping requests in parallel can also double-book, because the conflict check is not atomic. Add {'status': v['status'], 'awaiting': v.get('awaiting')} to the update filter and return 409 when modified_count == 0.
N+1: _enrich calls public_users once per row (up to 300). Batch the user lookup once for the whole list.

ui_bugs.issue: The secondary CTA label 'Tomorrow · 10:00' is truncated to 'Tomorrow …' at 390px: the button is about 166px wide next to the Save, Share and Chat icons. 'Today · 15:00' only just fits (scrollWidth 115 vs clientWidth 114), so 'Wed 28 Oct · 11:00' is at risk too. Use a short day ('Tmrw'/'Wed 28') or adjustsFontSizeToFit. Reference: app/property/[id].tsx:790-798

ui_bugs.component: Map pin at the viewport edge
ui_bugs.issue: After tapping a pin and closing the preview, the map stays panned and the neighbouring '₦310M' pin sits at x=328, so its label is cut off by the right screen edge. Pins can also sit under the zoom (−) control (₦285M at about x 298–385, y 345–378, against the button at 330–378, 312–360).

issues: White text on the Sale green #1F9D55 has about 3.5:1 contrast. That is below AA 4.5:1 for 16.5px text (16.5px bold does not count as 'large'). Red is 4.8:1 and blue 5.2:1. A darker green such as #178245 would give about 4.9:1.
The gold lock-open icon (#D4AF37) on red or green unlocked pins has very low contrast (about 2:1).
Cluster discs are still brand red, the same colour as Rent pins, so in the Buy/Lease views a red cluster reads as 'rent'. Use the ink/dark colour or a neutral for clusters.
The pin accessibilityLabel still says 'For sale'/'To rent' using only category, so lease and shortlet pins are announced as 'To rent' (app/(tabs)/index.tsx:658).

Timeline timestamps use the device locale and timezone ('10/25/2026, 11:27:42 AM', which is UTC in the browser) while the card says 'Lagos time'. Format them in Lagos time like the rest of the screen (e.g. 'Sun 25 Oct · 12:27').

The agent-viewings-entry subtitle always ends with '· set your viewing hours', even though Adaeze has hours set ('2 upcoming · set your viewing hours'). Show 'hours set' / the hours summary when has_hours is true (agent-dashboard.tsx:241).
The per-day switch hours-toggle-N is 40x20px, below the 44pt touch target. Make the whole day row pressable or add hitSlop.
On web the focused reason TextInput shows a double border: the browser focus outline inside the Input frame.

action_items: viewings.py complete_viewing: reject when start > now (409).
viewings.py HoursWindow: validate real clock times (00–23 hours, 00–59 minutes) and non-overlapping windows; today invalid hours can cause a 500 in _inside_hours.
viewings.py _transition: make state changes conditional ({id, status, awaiting} filter, 409 when modified_count == 0), so concurrent confirm/cancel/propose can't both win or double-book.
property/[id].tsx: stop the booked-state CTA label being truncated ('Tomorrow …') — use a shorter day label or auto-shrink.

Map: darken the Sale green for AA contrast with white text; make clusters a neutral colour, not rent red; fix the pin a11y label for lease/shortlet; improve contrast of the lock-open icon on unlocked pins.
Viewing detail timeline: format timestamps in Lagos time.
Agent dashboard viewings card: don't say 'set your viewing hours' when hours are set.
Availability: give hours-toggle a 44pt touch target.

Minor: ViewingSheet shows at most 21 days but the backend allows 30 (keep them the same). The Share icon in the property CTA has testID 'chat-agent-btn' (misleading). PricePin.tsx lines 5-9 still describe the old pin look.
critical_code_review_comments: PricePin.tsx header comment (lines 1-10) describes the previous scheme (white pill, red = sale, saved red ring, unlocked gold pill, selected brand red); it no longer matches the code.

pinHalfWidth assumes 5.4px per glyph, but at 16.5px weight 800 the real glyphs are about 9–10px: ₦285M renders 93px wide, and with the icon ₦3.8M/yr is 133px against PIN_HALF_W 62 → 124px. Edge-fit maths therefore underestimates the widest pins.
The buyer's propose sheet marks the buyer's own confirmed slot as 'Taken': taken includes every confirmed viewing, while the backend excludes the viewing's own id.
Writing files under /app/backend/tests triggers a uvicorn WatchFiles reload of the backend (seen in logs); this can cause flakes in tests that run in parallel.
EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY invalid/missing errors appear in the backend logs (push is best-effort; this was there before this change).

success_rate.backend: 93% (13/14 test functions incl. test_viewings.py; the 1 failure is the /complete bug)
success_rate.frontend: 92% (all requested flows work; 1 CTA truncation bug, plus design issues)

rca_of_issue: /complete: complete_viewing (viewings.py:410-415) checks only role == agent and status == confirmed; the 'start <= now' rule exists only in _enrich.can_complete. Repro: as Tunde, confirm a viewing 4 days ahead, then POST /api/viewings/{id}/complete → 200 and status 'completed'.
